title: Introduce cross-tenant token cohort sampler and contextual alert prioritizer
author: Priya Nair
commits: Initial implementation of cross-tenant cohort sampler and basic unit tests
Add alert prioritizer and gating logic for quiet windows
Console: wire token cohort overview panels and sparkline widgets
Add integration tests for sampler + prioritizer interplay

release_notes: Added a cross-tenant token cohort sampler to reduce cardinality of token-level telemetry while preserving tail signal; introduced contextual alert prioritizer that weights alerts by cohort impact and request-criticality; dashboard panels and docs included. Rollout guarded by feature flag 'cohort_sampler_v1'.
description:
Motivation and summary: We observed that token-level telemetry and token-cost attribution have grown in cardinality as product teams create diverse prompt templates. High-cardinality leads to noisy alerts and expensive ingestion/storage. This PR introduces a cross-tenant token cohort sampler (reservoir-based, LRU decays) that groups similar prompt shapes and token-phase signatures into cohorts for sampling and rollup. A companion component — the contextual alert prioritizer — reorders/reduces alert noise by scoring candidate alerts using cohort-level impact, recent cost delta, and a route-criticality multiplier.

Design highlights: 1) Sampler algorithm: lightweight fingerprinting of prompt-shape + model+seq-dist -> cohort key. Each cohort maintains a capped reservoir of invocation anchors (N=256 default) with LRU-decay on low-traffic cohorts. Reservoir entries carry prefetched KV-cache footprints and a compact phase histogram to enable per-phase latency breakdowns without needing full traces for every request. 2) Prioritizer: Alert candidates are enriched with cohort signal (cost delta, anomaly z-score) and request metadata (tenant SLA tier, route importance). The prioritizer applies a tunable policy to suppress low-impact alerts and to escalate high-impact cohort regressions. 3) Rollup: cohorts emit summarized metrics (token_cost_p50/p95 by phase, cohort_query_count, cohort_kv_miss_rate) with a compact tag set to avoid cardinality explosion. 4) Console: new dashboard 'Token Cohort Overview' summarizes cohort heatmaps, long-tail cohort traces, and prioritized-alert feed.

Files changed (high level): See files_changed_high_level. Key code lives in telemetry/sampler and telemetry/alerts. The console dashboard JSON wires new panels; docs include rollout and migration guidance.

Testing and perf: Unit tests added for sampler edge cases, integration tests validate the prioritizer against replayed production traces (subset sanitized). Microbench: sampler adds ~0.6ms median to request path in optimized build, worst-case +2.4ms for first-seen cohort (prefetch paths mitigate subsequent requests). Memory: capped reservoir keeps per-cohort memory bounded; global cohort table size is configurable and monitored.

Rollout plan: 1) Feature-flagged behind cohort_sampler_v1; opt-in per-tenant. 2) Enable for small number of low-risk tenants for 48h with traffic replay; monitor cohort coverage and missed tail alerts. 3) Gradual ramp to 25% of tenants over two weeks with automatic rollback on error-rate or metric-regression alarms. 4) Default enablement for all non-enterprise tenants after four weeks unless explicitly disabled.

Backward compatibility and migration: Prioritizer is additive: if disabled, existing alert rules remain unchanged. Cohort rollups produce new metric names with stable mapping; existing dashboards unaffected. Migration doc includes a mapping for token-level metric names and recommended alert adjustments.

Checklist: - [x] Core sampler + reservoir store implemented - [x] Prioritizer policy engine and unit tests - [x] Console dashboard and basic visualizations - [x] Integration tests with replay harness - [x] Docs + rollout plan - [x] Feature flag + metrics to monitor enablement

Related work: ENG-4873 (token-cost-scaling) and ENG-4920 (alert-fatigue). This complements earlier token-rollup efforts by moving sampling earlier (in-proxy) and bridging cohorts across tenants to preserve shared signal for rare long-tail templates.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main. Post-merge actions: deploy sampler behind feature flag in staging, schedule a 48h smoke window and fill in observability-runbook entries for the new cohort coverage metrics.
notes_for_sre: Watch cohort_table_size, cohort_eviction_rate, cohort_kv_miss_rate, token_cohort_p95_phase_latency. If cohort_eviction_rate spikes > 10% sustained, reduce global_cohort_max or increase reservoir cap for impacted tenants. The prioritizer emits metrics 'alert_priority_score' and 'alert_suppressed' to validate suppression behavior.
changelog_entry: Feature: Cross-tenant token cohort sampling and contextual alert prioritizer (feature-flagged). Adds new metrics and a Token Cohort Overview dashboard.
